integrity: Analytic all-size proof, independently coded exhaustive small-cycle tests and reproducible verifier; no claim of independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Pure Nash equilibria under unrestricted unilateral jumps only, on simple cycles and identical exactly-one-occupied-neighbor binary preferences. Neither mixed preferences nor other graph topologies or dynamics are included; an unindexed equivalent formulation might exist.
title: Two-family equilibrium classification for one-neighbor preferences on cyclic networks
